verdict.rationale: Fellow is an AI meeting-notes SaaS, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains no statement about AI model training or a training opt-out. Retention policies (including zero-day retention), transcript redaction, pausing recording, and admin deletion are adjacent privacy controls, not a documented way to keep data out of model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
